description: Angular component class for configuring a value stepper widget, including form setup, validation, and UI logic.

classes.name: ValueStepperBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring a value stepper widget, extending BasicWidgetConfigComponent.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for widget configuration.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided configuration data.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the widget configuration data based on form values.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form control paths that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on current form state.

methods.name: buttonValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables button-related form controls.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons are enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets card button configuration based on selected buttons.

methods.name: _valuePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string of the current value based on form settings.
